mapper.select: SELECT r.*,(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM admin a JOIN admin_role ar ON ar.admin_id=a.id WHERE ar.role_id=r.id) AS member_count FROM role r ORDER BY r.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role (name, code, description, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{description}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM role r INNER JOIN admin_role ar ON r.id = ar.role_id WHERE ar.admin_id = #{adminId}
